purpose: Second bounded architecture experiment. Hold the worklog-28 sparse relation structure fixed (same K=32 probes, frames, geometric descriptor, split, operator class, budget, seeds) and change ONE factor: each current hit additionally carries a runtime-constructible radiometric value, the frozen RNA's own rendering of the remote hit toward the query. Matched ZERO and SHUFFLED controls isolate alignment from extra channels.
written_before: any computation of the radiometric proxy on teaset data and any training of a worklog-29 branch

worklog28_reference.reuse: probe directions, frames, ray casting, 20-channel geometric descriptor, remote canonical pull-back, stable queries, references and frozen pixels are read from the worklog-28 probe and dataset files after checking that the unchanged worklog-28 code reproduces them bit for bit; branch A (geometric-only) predictions are the worklog-28 relational_s0/s1/s2 predictions, reused unretrained
reproduction_checks: re-cast probes with rrp_probes.cast_probes equal the stored worklog-28 probe arrays
re-assembled 20-channel descriptors equal the stored worklog-28 dataset probes
this batch's training loop run on the 20-channel descriptor with seed 0 reproduces worklog-28 relational_s0's validation curve

radiometric_proxy.name: L_hat_remote_to_query (runtime radiometric proxy; NOT exact current incident radiance)
radiometric_proxy.definition: for a probe hit j of query i: the frozen T0 RNA (worklog-22 checkpoint, canonical mode) rendered at j with the query as camera, exactly as rna_infer.py renders a pixel sample: position = j's canonical pull-back (hit - t_part) normalised by the training-H5 AABB; camera_dir = unit vector j -> i (= minus the probe direction); normal = j's current shading normal faced toward i; 16 area-light samples at j from the existing rna_bridge.area_light_samples on the current lit scene (protocol emitter, 4x4 strata at their centres, deterministic), each with current segment visibility; radiance = mean over samples of where(vis, lit, shadow branch).clamp(0) * weight / training light intensity
radiometric_proxy.contains: the frozen RNA's persistent appearance at j (including whatever canonical transport its triplane+MLP baked in), evaluated for the current direction toward the query and the current direct-light visibility at j
radiometric_proxy.does_not_contain: current indirect illumination at j beyond RNA's direct-visibility branch switch, any recursive query of another relation, any path tracing, any reference radiance, state identity or transform
radiometric_proxy.lit_scene: teaset_parts.scene_dict(64, <state translations>, cross-backbone lighting): same geometry plus the protocol emitter; the probe ray is re-cast there to obtain the hit for light sampling and must land on the same point as in the geometry-only probe scene
radiometric_proxy.encoding: log1p(max(RGB, 0)) on hits; misses carry 0 in these channels, with the existing worklog-28 'hit' channel as the explicit miss flag

branches.A_geometric_wl28: historical worklog-28 relational branch (20 channels); predictions reused
branches.B_zero: worklog-29 architecture (23 channels per probe), proxy channels set to 0 for every probe
branches.C_shuffled: 23 channels; within each state the proxy values of hit probes are permuted by numpy default_rng(29029).permutation (same seed for every state, never across states); misses stay 0; marginal distribution of hit values preserved, alignment destroyed
branches.matching: B, C, D share architecture, parameter count, optimiser, steps, split, seeds; only the proxy semantics differ. A differs by the 3 input channels of the first layer (192 weights)

model.note: only the first layer's input dimension changes (20 -> 23); no width or depth change

split.note: identical to worklog 28; normalisation statistics from the training split of the training states only

primary_metric.E_delta: mean over stable T3 pixels paired with T0 (identical queries) and RGB of |(tm(N_T3) - tm(N_T0)) - (tm(G_T3) - tm(G_T0))|, tm = display transform clamp(x^(1/2.2)); N = frozen RNA + branch residual, G = mean of the locked seed-A/B references
primary_metric.R_delta: E_delta / mean |tm(G_T3) - tm(G_T0)| on the same pixels
primary_metric.space: display, as worklog 28's change-error diagnostic; linear values also reported
secondary: historical refit_block ratio and gain (own T0 and frozen T0)

success_test.1: every seed: R_delta(D_real) < R_delta(B_zero) of the same seed
success_test.2: every seed: R_delta(D_real) < R_delta(C_shuffled) of the same seed
success_test.4: the signed T3 change map of D follows the moved transport structure better than A, B and C (reviewer judgement recorded in the worklog with the ROI provenance)
success_test.verdict: D PASSES only if 1-4 all hold; otherwise D FAILS and only the exact-direction oracle is run
success_test.not_required: the historical worklog-22 recovery rule (reported as supporting evidence)

t1_control: as worklog 28: absolute T1 error, own-T0 error, correction difference T0 -> T1 (mean |(N_T1 - F_T1) - (N_T0 - F_T0)| over T1 pixels paired to T0 by idx0), GT change, correction norm, signed maps
state_diagnostics: proxy magnitude distribution (hit probes, per state)
fraction of probes whose proxy changes vs T0 (paired queries)
Pearson and Spearman correlation across stable pixels of per-pixel proxy change norm with |G_state - G_T0|

T3: fraction of hit-probe proxy values outside the training-state range per channel; fraction of queries whose summed proxy or moved-part hit count exceeds the training range (geometry vs radiometric extrapolation)

exact_direction_oracle.when: only if D_real FAILS the success test
exact_direction_oracle.state: same 23-channel layout; the 3 proxy channels replaced by log1p of the path-traced incident radiance along each of the same 32 probe directions from the same query origin in the current lit scene (Mitsuba C++ path, max_depth -1, rr_depth 5, wavefront, as the references); emitter hits included
exact_direction_oracle.noise_check: two independent seeds; report per-probe repeat noise in the encoded channels and per-pixel aggregated noise against the T0 -> T3 change of the same quantity; the oracle trains on seed A
exact_direction_oracle.contract: same queries, directions, training states, hold-outs, operator, budget, seeds; diagnostic only, never a method

cases.O1: oracle meets success criterion 3 (>= 2/3 seeds R_delta <= 0.50) while D failed: the runtime proxy is the bottleneck
cases.O2: oracle also fails: K=32 support / aggregation / training coverage remain entangled; stop

items: frozen RNA rendering of the ROI queries

stop_conditions: lit-scene probe hits differ from the geometry-only hits
T3 enters training, selection or statistics
the proxy needs path tracing or references
